title: FIRSTNONBLANK returns the first value of the column for which the measure is not BLANK

source.quote: Returns the first value in the column for which the expression has a non blank value.
source.supports: the first value, in the order of the column values, whose expression is not blank

source.quote: A table containing a single column and single row with the computed first value.
source.supports: the result is a one-row table of the column

derivation: Countries in order: FR, JP, US. The measure does a context transition for each: FR (Dee) has no sales, BLANK; JP (Cho) is 230. The first non-blank is JP.
